pages.text:
Redcliffe Farm
Redcliffe Farm is a family run campsite situated on the edge of the River Frome amidst the heart of the Dorset countryside and only a 15 minute (approx 1km) walk from the historic market town of  Wareham .
The Site makes an ideal base for camping, walking, cycling, bird-watching and enjoying the lovely Purbeck countryside with its famous Jurassic Coastline and wonderful beaches.
The location of the Redcliffe Farm Campsite and the proximity to the River Frome and Poole Harbour also make it ideal for fishing, boating or simply relaxing.
Redcliffe Farm Campsite is in a beautiful rural area of Dorset and within easy reach of many local towns and beaches . The campsite enjoys views of Poole Harbour, the River Frome and the Purbecks.
If you have ever considered camping in and around Dorset, or would like to find out more about Redcliffe Farm Campsite then please get in touch .
Redcliffe Farm has its own private slipway (approximately 100m from the site entrance). A 15 minute trip down the river will take you directly into Poole Harbour.
The slipway is open to day visitors as well as campsite users and is suitable for motorboats on trailers, dinghys, kayaks and paddleboards. Ample parking is available adjacent to the slipway. Day charges apply. (we are unable to take card payment for slipway use)
Wareham is a beautiful historic Dorset market town with a variety of local shops, high quality restaurants and a weekly market on Wareham Quay.
View our Camping Prices and book with us.

About Us Redcliffe Farm
About Us
About Redcliffe Farm Campsite
The mainly level site provides pitches for caravans and tents with or without electric hookups. Without a hookup you are free to pitch virtually where you like within allocated areas.
For couples and singles who prefer a little more peace we have introduced a quiet field at the top of the site for small tents only.
We try and keep the site as relaxed as possible and if the office is closed we visit you on site to book you in. Dogs are permitted as long as they are on a lead on site. There is a large adjacent field where they can be exercised.
Although we don t have a shop on site, the 15 minute walk along the tow path is such a pleasant one nobody ever seems to mind. There is a large area where children and adults can play ball games, fly kites, etc. This is not available at bank holidays.
If you have ever considered camping in and around Dorset, or would like to find out more about Redcliffe Farm Campsite then please get in touch .
